excluded: claim of proving randomness or predictability

joint_null: conditional on game, number_space_version and documented_draw_process_version, draws are independent across observed issues and each zone is a fixed-cardinality uniform sample without replacement; zones follow the documented separate draw procedure
calendar_policy: preserve exact observed issues, dates, missing issues and generation-segment membership; regenerate numbers only
multiplicity_family: the union of every primary candidate decision across both games and generation segments; negative-control rejections are counted for calibration but cannot become candidate signals
